reconstruction_accuracy.unit: game units (a player is about 40 wide)
reconstruction_accuracy.excluded: victim coordinate (shares a writer with the track's death sample)

line_of_sight.scope: oracle diagnostic, world view only: a clear ray from the observer's eye to at least one point of the target's body in the static geometry — necessary, not sufficient, for having seen someone (§6.1); never a belief source

validated_by.compared_to: engine et.trap_Trace with passEntityNum=-2 (world-only), paired offline/live fixtures
validated_by.caveat: the engine's bullet trace also clips runtime entities and antilag positions (MASK_SHOT, G_HistoricalTrace); a clear static ray is an upper bound

notes: line-of-sight is an ORACLE DIAGNOSTIC, world view only: a clear ray is necessary, not sufficient, for having seen someone (§6.1); validated against the engine's world trace by W6 (99.92 %); never a belief source
recently_contested means an engagement was open, which the tracker holds for up to 15s after the last hit — not 'under attack'
distances are geometric separation, not tactical support distance
`gaps` names every player without a state here and why; a player is never simply absent
